Sophia: Quick async standup — model onboarding + evals.

Sophia: Yesterday: onboarded t5-medium-quant into staging, ran evals on prompt_set_v3 (1000 cases). Observed ~1.6% quality regression on NER extraction vs baseline.
Blocker: failing edge-case in date parsing when timezone present.
Today: triage regression, try fallback to fp16 model variant, open CR for prompt normalization.

Kevin: Can you paste the eval summary + a couple failing examples?

Sophia: Sure — sample failing case below:
```
input: "Event on 2023-11-05T22:00:00Z — send invite"
expected: "2023-11-05"
model: "Nov 5th"
```
Also saw a pattern where tokenizer splits timezone into token that confuses postproc.

Maria: re: tokenizer — probably due to the whitespace normalization I landed for tokenization. @Sasha any thoughts?

Sasha: That was my change. I can revert or add a special-case for ISO timestamps. I pushed a quick patch to the post-process to normalize dates to isoformat and will run a smoke test.

Tony: I'll queue a rerun on the eval runner with `--subset failing_cases --batch-size 8` — ETA ~20m.

eval-bot: Eval run 1768467025 started: model=t5-medium-quant, dataset=prompt_set_v3, cases=48/48, status=running

Kevin: Sophia, please add failing examples to prompt_set_v3/bugs so we can track. Also pinging for CR review: github.com/redwood/pr/482

Sophia: Added examples in /evals/bugs/2026-03-17. PR #482 is up, @Kevin can you review? Blocker: I don't have permission to trigger dedicated fleets for fallback deploy — @Maria can you grant?

Maria: Granted fleet-deploy to the onboarding group. You should be good.

Sasha: Rerun finished — numbers improved, regression down to ~0.5% on NER. Found a new failure class on long descriptions; logging that as follow-up.

Sophia: Great. I'll sanity-check a handful of prod-like prompts; if green we'll do a canary tomorrow morning. Thanks all :rocket:
